name: Cervical Strain / Acute Mechanical Neck Pain
definition: Acute neck pain related to muscular, ligamentous or nonspecific mechanical irritation without major neurological deficit or serious structural disease.

investigations.principle: Imaging is not routine in uncomplicated acute mechanical neck pain.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs/CT are used when trauma or bony pathology is suspected.

green: Reassurance and normal activity as tolerated
amber: Avoid prolonged collar use in uncomplicated cases.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Acute neck pain related to muscular, ligamentous or nonspecific mechanical irritation without major neurological deficit or serious structural disease.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Cervical Neck Pain or Cervical Radiculopathy
